{{Engineer infobox}}

Eleanor Bresa specialises in weapon performance modifications for suits and handheld weapons.<ref name="inara-list" />

Odyssey Engineering is a separate system from ship Engineering — it modifies suits and handheld weapons rather than ship modules, and exists only in Live (there is no Legacy equivalent). See [[Engineers]] for how the two systems are organised.

== Location ==
* '''System:''' Desy
* '''Settlement:''' Bresa Modifications
* '''Region:''' Colonia — this Engineer is only reachable after making the long journey to the Colonia region, separate from the core bubble.

== How to Discover This Engineer ==
Eleanor Bresa is independently available and does not require a referral from another Engineer.<ref name="inara-list">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineers/ Engineers], Inara.</ref>

== How to Receive an Invitation ==
There is no separate invitation requirement distinct from the unlock requirement below.

== How to Unlock This Engineer ==
The unlock requirements are summarized in the discovery and invitation sections above.

For the complete step-by-step process, see [[Unlocking Eleanor Bresa]].

== Engineer Unlock Chain ==
Eleanor Bresa is one of three independent Colonia Odyssey Engineers (alongside [[Baltanos]] and [[Rosa Dayette]]) whose referral tasks all feed into [[Yi Shen]].<ref name="inara-list" />

After Eleanor Bresa is unlocked, delivering '''10 Digital Designs''' completes the referral task toward Yi Shen. All three Colonia Engineers' referral tasks must be completed before Yi Shen becomes available.
